mechanism: Both drugs are renally cleared and may compete for renal elimination, potentially increasing concentrations of ganciclovir (which has significant nephrotoxicity); atovaquone is highly protein-bound and may displace ganciclovir, increasing free drug levels.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, and consider dose adjustment of ganciclovir based on creatinine clearance; assess for signs of nephrotoxicity.
